text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I got plenty of rest~! I even carried out 
my original Operation Sound Sleep! Namely—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Operation: Straight to Bed After a Warm 
Bath"! It worked like a charm!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu, I wrote down all the details of 
the strategy in my notes, so don't worry! 
I'll share it with the Trainer later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, it seems she was able to get 
some solid rest!
